::: {.rq-lesson}
**Where to start.** The game begins at **Region 1 · Basics**: no statistics background needed. Take the **[Region 1 pre-test](r1pretest.qmd)** (a baseline, not graded), then open *Your First Script*. After Region 1 (post-test 70% or more) comes **Region 2 · Moderate**, and then Region 3. Already comfortable with R? Take the **[placement check](readiness.qmd)**; if it says *Ready*, take the **[pre-test](pretest.qmd)** and go straight to **Region 3 · Regression**.

**How it works.** Clear worlds in order. Each world has a short briefing, levels of questions and a **boss**. Earn **XP** (★ = 10/20/30), keep a **daily streak**, collect **badges**, and rank up from *Field Volunteer* to *Chief Biostatistician*.

- First try = full XP · second try = ½ · later = ¼ · **hints cost XP** (3, 5, 8) · *Show answer* = 0 XP
- A world unlocks after you reach the pass mark in the previous one (you can always override: it is *your* learning)
- Every world has **📖 Read first** links to the workshop pages that teach it (see the *Library* menu)
- Progress is saved **in this browser only**. Use *Export* to back it up or move devices
:::

## The map

Regions 1 · Basics, 2 · Moderate and 3 · Regression are playable. Region 4 is being built.
